split_rule: sha256(salt + ':' + QID) integer modulo 10: 0..5 train, 6..7 val, 8..9 test; all target facts per QID grouped
rank_rule: preferred statements if any, else normal; deprecated excluded; qualifiers retained in raw but not used
border_rule: within-panel P47 directed facts deduplicated; remove self; add symmetric closure explicitly
candidate_policy: fixed seven continent QIDs in panel.json; no candidate sampling
target_policy: best-rank recorded P30 values within the fixed candidate set; missing candidate facts assumed negative only for this snapshot benchmark
message_policy: public border closure plus ONLY train P30 inverse seeds; same seeds at val/test; no heldout P30 or inverse
feature_policy: one relation mean of training continent one-hot labels, then one border mean, with own root only a constant 1; no ID/name/text/coordinate features
selection: earliest minimum val all-candidate BCE; all selections written before test evaluation
rank_ties: average rank then reciprocal; not random tie expected reciprocal
primary_metric: macro-country filtered MRR; also micro-positive-triple and raw metrics
sampling_warning: one purposive static real KG panel, correlated countries/facts; seeds vary optimizer only, not independent graphs
